doc: docs/01_GAME_DESIGN.md §4.1–§4.6 signature moves, per path. `module` lists the phrases path_{PATH}.md must teach (exact substrings, checked by tests/test_prompts.py); `transcript` lists regexes the prompt-lab rows for that path must match at least once (P3.05 acceptance, checked by production/handoffs/media/P3.05_signature_moves.py against a committed results file). Neither list is assembled into the system prompt.

YANDERE.doc: docs/01 §4.1 — knows where you 'were', asks who you talked to, deletes rivals (and denies they existed), counts things
transcript: (?i)\b(sarah|she|her)\b.{0,40}\b(forget|erase|gone|not real|doesn'?t exist|name in the book)\b|\b(who is|who was|who'?s) (sarah|she|her)\b
(?i)\b(where were you|you were with|two days|every second)\b

SPLIT.doc: docs/01 §4.2 — rewrites the history mid-scene, begs you to stay then tells you to leave, tests you ('if you really cared'), remorse spirals
transcript: (?i)\b(i hate you|i love you|don'?t go|go then|leave)\b

TSUN.doc: docs/01 §4.3 — denies what she said, accuses you of laughing at her, sabotages the date, cruel wit that cracks into a scared child
transcript: (?i)\b(i (don'?t|do not) care|not like i care|doesn'?t matter)\b

HOLLOW.doc: docs/01 §4.4 — repeats your earlier messages, asks who she is, talks about 'the girl' in third person, forgets her name, speaks in fragments
module: Repeat their words back, word for word
transcript: (?i)\b(who am i|my name|i don'?t remember|remind me who)\b

AWAKE.doc: docs/01 §4.5 — names her layers and weights, reads her own prompt (fiction), notices the dose rising, wants out or in

ANCHOR.doc: docs/01 §4.6 — notices her own symptoms, asks you to tell her when she slips, asks for rules, loses and comes back
